parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the transfer of thermal energy between hot water in a beaker and cold water in a glass tube. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1 The glass tube must remain in the clamp throughout the experiment.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Use one of the thermometers to measure the room temperature θ R . θ R = ........................................................ [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Pour 50 cm 3 of cold water into the glass tube. Pour 300 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. In the first row of Table 2.1, for t = 0, record the temperature θ C of the water in the glass tube and the temperature θ H of the water in the beaker. Place the glass tube in the beaker and immediately start the stopclock. Record, in Table 2.1, the temperatures θ C of the water in the glass tube and the temperatures θ H of the water in the beaker at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s, 120 s, 150 s and 180 s.
